Alongside the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3 and the up to $130 off Apple Watch Series 11, today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by Amazon re-stocking select M5 MacBook Air models at $150 off and the Amazon Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro models at $220 off today (plus more up to $449 off). We also have Eve’s wireless HomeKit orb lamp with Siri at 25% off, the first discount on the new Bose Lifestyle Ultra soundbar and speakers bundle at $250 off, and Nomad leather iPhone 17/Air cases up to 30% off. Head below for a closer look at all of those and much more.

Score a new set of AirPods Pro 3 for the summer at nearly $50 off right now, more from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $149 (Reg. $179)

Upgrade your Apple Watch this summer while Series 11 is down at $299 (All colors)

The summer is summering, and Apple Watch Series 11 deals are flying with straight $100 cash discounts on the most affordable model you can buy. Whether you have some summer birthdays to take care off, a back to school gift, or just looking to upgrade your personal care routine, you can save some cash.

We might very well catch some deeper deals later this fall, but if you are looking to pickup a current-generation Apple wrist computer for whatever reason you might want or need right now, there’s a ton of cash to be saved.

The 42mm model – the most affordable Series 11 you can buy – is currently on sale for $299 shipped. We featured this deal when it first when live over this past weekend, but now Amazon has all four case colors down at the discounted rate: Jet Black, Rose Gold, Silver, and Space Gray.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $499)

We are talking about a regularly $399 current-gen Apple Watch here at a straight up $100 off the list price.

And if you must have the larger 46mm case size, most, but not all, colors on that one are also sitting at $100 off the list price right now as well. And be sure to pay close attention to that 46mm Cell model below as well – that one is $130 off right now:

  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $529)

Amazon re-stocks select M5 MacBook Air models at $150 off new list prices

While it is serving up a notable deal on AirPods Pro 3 this week, Amazon has had a tough time over the last couple weeks keeping the new M5 MacBook Air in stock at discounted prices as it attempts to undercut other retailers. The MSRPs have gone up at Apple and other retailers, but Amazon does have a few models back in stock at $150 off as of this morning.

While recently the 15-inch form-factor has been the model most readily available with price relief from the new higher price tags, today we have a couple configurations on the less pricey 13-inch back in stock in a few different color options:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (Reg. $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,649 (Reg. $1,799)

We did get a quick taste of some lower price tags just after Apple announced and launched the new higher list prices across the M5 MacBook Air lineup, but those deals are long gone now. If you are looking to land a new machine this summer, something in the range of $150 off is effectively the new sweet spot at this point.

For comparison’s sake, despite being in the midst of its Appreciation Sale this week, Best Buy is charging full price for the M5 MacBook Air across the board. Amazon, might seemingly be struggling to keep all models in stock at this point, but it is delivering select configs at well below the list prices here today.

Amazon has Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro models at $220 off today, more up to $449 off

We have tracked some notable deals on Amazon’s refurbished iPhone 17 Pro units thus far, but the price drops on its top-quality Renewed Premium units haven’t but all that great until now. We are now tracking up to $220 off the new list prices on all three colors of the latest iPhone 17 Pro.

All of these listings below are sold and shipped straight from Amazon (not some third-party seller) and deliver Renewed Premium units – the highest quality Amazon sells with a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life.”

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,199 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,199 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,199 (Reg. $1,299 new)

The real highlights here are the 1TB models that are now $220 under the list price on a brand new unlocked 17 Pro straight from Apple. The 512GB models are $100 off, but that is perhaps not quite enough to side-step a new unit for some folks.

Nonetheless these are among the best deals we have tracked on the new Renewed Premium units from Amazon, but you will still find “excellent” refurbished units for less right now at Amazon – the main difference here is the 90-day Amazon Renewed Guarantee and the battery “capacity that exceeds 80% of” the original battery life:

  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Deep Blue $1,107 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Cosmic Orange $1,139 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Silver $1,120 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Cosmic Orange $1,240 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Deep Blue $1,263 (Reg. $1,499)

These 17 Pro Max models from Woot are up to $49 off – “PRISTINE and have never been in customer hands” while also arriving with a “test sticker showing 100% battery life and inside a sleek custom black box.”

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (Reg. $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,450 (Reg. $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB $1,550 (Reg. $1,999)

Eve’s wireless HomeKit orb lamp with Siri now 25% off at Amazon (Apple sells it for $100)

Eve’s smart HomeKit orb light is seeing a notable 25% price drop today at Amazon. Still one of the nicer portable lights of its kind of you ask me, it is now within a few bucks of the best price of the year.

Amazon is now offering the Eve Flare Portable Smart LED Lamp with Apple HomeKit down at $74.99 shipped. Regularly $100, this is 25% off the list price and the best we can find.

The Amazon listing does say it’s regularly $110, much like the official Eve site, but it is more realistically $100 and it sells for $100 on the official Apple Store everyday of the week.

New Bose Lifestyle Ultra soundbar and speakers bundle now $250 off (All-time low)

We spotted the first notable deal on the brand new Bose Lifestyle Ultra home speaker lineup when Amazon dropped the price on a pair of the new Alexa+/AirPlay Bose Lifestyle Ultra Speakers. Today, however, we are featuring nearly $250 off the new Bose Surround Sound Set that also includes the brand new Lifestyle Ultra Soundbar.

Amazon is now offering the Bose Surround Sound Set for $1,449 shipped – this includes one Lifestyle Ultra Soundbar and a pair of Lifestyle Ultra Speakers.

All combined this set would run you nearly $1,700 (purchasing it all individually), but with today’s savings you can knock nearly $250 off the total.

Much like we detailed previously, the new Bose Lifestyle lineup is yet to see any discounts outside of these bundle deals:

Rare Apple keyboards and black Magic Mouse deals (somehow) still live, all-time lows from $80

We certainly see our fair share of deals on prime time Apple tech – AirPods Pro 3 are $50 off and the most popular Apple Watch Series 11 models are up to $130 off right now – but the Magic accessories, not so much. However, we are (somehow) still seeing lingering Prime Day price drops on both the base Magic Keyboard and the full-size model with Touch ID, as well as the black Apple Magic Mouse.

Previous to these extended Prime Day discounts, deals on these Apple accessories were very rare, and there’s no telling how much longer these offers will remain.

  • Black Apple Magic Mouse $80 (Reg. $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard $80 (Reg. $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard full-size with Touch ID $145 (Reg. $179)

All three are sitting at the lowest prices we have tracked on Amazon to date. It had been a very long time since we had seen the black Apple Magic Mouse down at a price this low (I’m certainly looking to score a backup at the moment), and both of these Magic Keyboard models are at the lowest prices ever – only once before this recent sale has the base model been down this low and we had never seen the Touch ID variant under $158.

If you are looking to refresh your Magic Apple input devices, now might be the time to do it while these ongoing Prime Day prices are still poppin’.

Nomad’s giant sitewide Anniversary sale now live: Rare deals on MagSafe chargers, cases, Watch bands, more

Nomad has just launched one of its biggest sales events of the year, with deals spanning its range of iPNomad has just launched one of its biggest sales events of the year, with deals spanning its range of iPhone 17 leather cases, Apple Watch bands, cables, Find My Tracking Card (we were told this was going on sale today, but it is yet to go live), its gorgeous Stand One Max 3-in-1 25W MagSafe Charger, wallets, and more. Alongside all of the deals in its Overstock Sale section, you’re looking at up to 30% off some of its latest-generation gear and a host of rare price drops here on the official site.

Nomad Anniversary Sale

The Nomad Anniversary Sale is among its biggest discount events of the year. While there are sales on the official site from time-to-time, we are talking about a brand that didn’t offer any deals during Prime Day this year and, unlike many accessory makers, doesn’t run a sale at every chance it gets during national holidays and the like.

If you have had your eye on any of the brand’s gear, you’ll want to dive in while you can. We are told the Nomad Anniversary Sale will run from today through July 20, but, if this thing goes anything like its other major deal events, the best stuff could sell out well before that.

Here’s a quick rundown of some highlight deals here and a look at some of the brand’s gear that rarely sees straight up cash discounts:
